encoder_arguments: title=Westerlund 2 F162M through recorded 2.2 m AO PSFs
comment=Existing 2 s record shown 20x slower. No AO rerun. Calibrated F162M surface brightness convolved with saved 1.65 um PSFs; fixed display stretch.
operations: Decode the validated 1280x720 lossless WebP presentation. No optical model, convolution, AO or metrics are recalculated.
Repeat each existing image at constant 60 fps. Preserve every original image, including frame 736. No blending or motion interpolation.
Encode H.264 with 4:2:0 chroma and fast-start MP4. This is a lossy sharing copy, not scientific image data.
